business: TradeCatch (a bilingual AI phone receptionist for Québec contractors)
target: Owners of trade and home-service businesses (solo to 10 employees) in Montréal, Laval and surrounding areas who miss calls while working on job sites or serving customers

segments.name: Solo contractor (plumber, electrician or HVAC), business revenue
Small service business, 2 to 5 employees (business revenue)
Renovation, roofing or landscaping business (business revenue)

behaviours.name: Misses calls on the job
behaviours.how: Frequently misses calls while working on job sites or serving customers; calls back when there is a minute.

behaviours.name: Personal phone, voicemail or an employee answers
behaviours.how: Relies on a personal cell, voicemail, or whichever employee is free to pick up.

behaviours.name: Uses scheduling or CRM software
behaviours.how: Already runs appointments in a scheduling or CRM tool and expects anything new to fit with it.

behaviours.name: Manages appointments by hand
behaviours.how: Keeps appointments in a paper agenda, a notebook or text messages.

behaviours.name: Wants it simple
behaviours.how: Prefers solutions that need minimal technical knowledge; will not configure software alone.

behaviours.name: Bilingual service matters
behaviours.how: Serves customers in both French and English and judges any service on how it sounds in both.

objections: 249 to 349 $ a month needs a clear return on investment.
Will the receptionist sound natural and understand my customers?
I'm afraid of losing customers to wrong answers or missed appointments.
Is it reliable, is my data private, and does it work with the tools I already use?
Can I keep my existing business phone number?
I want proof: a demonstration, testimonials or real results.
How quickly can it be up and running?
habits: you are up a ladder or under a sink when the phone rings
you quote three jobs a week and chase maybe one
you check your phone at lunch and again at 6 p.m.
your Google listing has 23 reviews and you have replied to none
winter is your busy season and you lose track of callbacks
you do your invoicing on Sunday night
you speak French on the job and English with half your Laval customers
you lost a $9,000 kitchen job last month because the quote sat unanswered
notes: Segments, behaviours and objections supplied by the founder on 2026-11-14. Revenue ranges per segment and the behaviour shares are estimates added by Claude; habits are Claude's illustrative context lines.
